title: 第1219章 天照大长老云中上仙第1218章 东方雷的大手笔
slug: 炼气家族我有一个造化空间
lines: “尔敢！”
造化仙宗集体震怒。
十几万修士齐声怒喝，声浪冲霄。
可，徒之奈何？
天仙后期大能出手，真仙修士连插手的资格都没有。
以雷燧、菡凤仙两名天仙后期大能为首的八名天仙，眸光闪烁，各有所思，并未第一时间出手阻止。
他们不出手，不是因为来不及，而是想看。
看造化仙宗的底蕴到底有多深？
“可恶！”
李青元等真仙修士，只能眼睁睁看着天仙后期大能突袭出手，祭出开天阵旗杀向护宗大阵。
开天阵旗光刃横空，所过之处虚空裂开一条漆黑裂缝，绵延数万里，如同天穹被一柄无形巨刃剖开。
杨小禾见多识广，脱口而出："这是五阶开天阵旗，专克阵法，同级别五阶天仙大阵，亦可一旗破之。"
"此物炼制不易，无比珍贵，且一面旗子只能使用三次。"
五阶开天阵旗，天仙中期级别的克阵法宝，专破阵法。
一旗之下，五阶天仙大阵也要被瞬间撕裂，大阵崩裂。
第一御极、李青元等人面色一变："专克阵法？可破五阶天仙大阵？"
"此人哪里是来祝贺，分明是来砸场子，要让我造化仙宗颜面扫地。"
立宗大典，万仙来贺。
若护宗大阵在众目睽睽之下被一旗破之，造化仙宗的颜面将荡然无存。
颜面事小，威信事大。
一座连护宗大阵都守不住的宗门，如何服众？如何镇压一域？
"勿忧，有我。"
空灵冷寂之声响起，十绝仙子曼妙身姿闪现，她立于造化仙宗仙脉核心，纤纤玉手一抬："起阵！"
"大寒弥天阵！"
大弥天阵，本是五阶阵法，堪比天仙中期大能。
而今，她融入自身阵法造诣，将其升级为"大寒弥天阵"，直接提升至五阶巅峰，堪比天仙中期圆满大能。
百年苦修，十绝仙子通过亲手炼制的阵旗，将自身绝对零度神通融入大阵，使大弥天阵脱胎换骨。
一字之增，天壤之别。
轰！
大寒弥天阵一开，其余两座天仙初期阵法，数十座真仙阵法同时运转，更有灵脉之上无数阵法一同运转，牵引天地之力。
content_en:
"You dare!"
The Creation Immortal Sect was collectively furious.
Hundreds of thousands of monks roared in unison, their voices rising into the sky.
But what can I do?
The Celestial Immortal can take action in the later stage, and the True Immortal monk is not even qualified to intervene.
The eight immortals, headed by Lei Sui and Han Fengxian, two late-stage immortals, had their eyes flickering and each had their own thoughts, but they did not immediately intervene to stop them.
They didn't take action not because they were too late, but because they wanted to see.
See how deep the foundation of the Good Fortune Immortal Sect is?
"Damn it!"
Li Qingyuan and other True Immortal cultivators could only watch helplessly as the powerful late-stage Celestial Immortals made a sudden attack, using the Opening Heaven Formation Flag to attack the Sect Protector Formation.
The light blade of the flag of the Open Sky Formation crossed the sky, and a dark crack opened in the void wherever it passed, stretching for tens of thousands of miles, as if the sky was cut open by an invisible giant blade.
Yang Xiaohe was well-informed and blurted out: "This is the fifth-level Open Heaven formation flag. It is designed to defeat formations. It can also break through the fifth-level Celestial Formation of the same level with one flag."
"This thing is not easy to refine, it is extremely precious, and a flag can only be used three times."
The fifth-level Open Heaven Formation Flag is a mid-level Celestial Immortal-level formation-defeating magic weapon that specializes in breaking formations.
Under a flag, the fifth-level Celestial Immortal Formation will be torn apart in an instant, and the formation will collapse.
The expressions of the First Yuji, Li Qingyuan and others changed: "Specialize in defeating formations? Can you break through the fifth-level Celestial Immortal Formation?"
"This person is not here to congratulate you. He is clearly here to cause trouble and make my Creation Immortal Sect lose face."
On the grand ceremony of establishing a clan, thousands of immortals came to congratulate.
If the sect-protecting formation is destroyed by a flag in full view of the public, the good fortune of the Immortal Sect will be lost.
Face is a small matter, but prestige is a big deal.
How can a sect that can't even defend its sect-protecting formation convince the public? How to suppress a region?
"Don't worry, I'm here."
The ethereal and cold voice sounded, and the graceful figure of the Shijue Fairy flashed. She stood at the core of the Immortal Vein of the Creation Immortal Sect, and raised her slender hand: "Start the formation!"
"Great Cold Formation!"
The Great Heavenly Formation is originally a fifth-level formation, comparable to the power of the mid-level Heavenly Immortal.
Now, she has integrated her own formation skills and upgraded it to the "Great Cold Heaven Formation", which has been directly promoted to the peak of the fifth level, comparable to the perfect power of the mid-stage immortal.
After a hundred years of hard training, Fairy Shijue integrated her absolute zero magical power into the formation through the formation flag that she refined with her own hands, transforming the Great Heavenly Formation.
One word adds a huge difference.
boom!
As soon as the Great Cold Heaven Formation was opened, the remaining two Celestial Immortal Initial Formations, dozens of True Immortal Formations were operating at the same time, and countless formations on the spiritual veins were operating together, pulling in the power of heaven and earth.
